properties.basis: OpenStreetMap water polygon (ODbL), relation 4472952 (9.0 km2), the Fionn Loch of Fisherfield north-east of Loch Maree. Annex 1 writes Loch Fionn and names no district. OS Open Names has three lochs called Fionn Loch: this one, one in Inverpolly south-east of Lochinver (0.8 km2) and a 0.002 km2 lochan on Colonsay. Every other whole-loch Category C entry is a sizeable loch (the smallest, Loch Insh, is 1.3 km2 in OSM), so this one is taken; the Inverpolly loch is left unclassified. Medium, not high, because Annex 1 does not say which
